The Eddy Covariance tower will be installed as temporary research infrastructure and will be dismantled and relocated to other research sites upon completion of the project. The tower and instrumentation therefore constitute reusable scientific infrastructure. Based on the market assessment, no reasonable alternative supplier was identified that could provide an equivalent integrated solution meeting all technical requirements for open-path methane Eddy Covariance measurements, synchronization, processing and compatibility with international flux research infrastructures and DTU therefore intends to award the contract to LI-COR Biosciences GmbH.
